name: 施設の説明と詳細リンク
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse component LH01-0031 施設の説明と詳細リンク. Input1 ORIGINAL Google Maps screenshot controls actual description meaning, hierarchy, spacing and fine details. Relevant region x47 y528 width1080 height233 contains ONLY Details heading and paragraph; despite the catalog name it shows NO separate detail link. Do not invent a link, button, icon or chevron. Input2 native mock secondary Japanese layout; its phrase散歩 changes the original people-watching meaning, so correct this as below. Input3 approved bus STYLE ONLY.
Create one compact horizontal white rounded description card, purewhite#FFFFFF canvas, thin neutral edge and restrained soft downward shadow. Exact small heading "施設の詳細". Under it exact source-faithful Japanese paragraph: "幅広い世代の地域の人々が、ピクニックや人間観察を楽しむ屋外スポットです。" Use natural two-line wrapping with clear comfortable line spacing; avoid a one-character orphan. No facility name, extra facts or guessed details. This faithfully translates the source's locals of all ages, picnics and people-watching, without the mock's unsupported walking activity.
Accent decision: original description region is neutral text with no selected/action state; keep it neutral. No forced green, blue link, random icon or mint fill. Ink#1D1D1D heading; secondary#6E6E6E paragraph. Locked Meiryo headingRegular40014/24 and bodyRegular40014/24, tracking0, no bold heading or body. Native mock is the typography-weight guide, ORIGINAL information/details take priority. Modest compact padding, no nested boxes, flat frontal high-resolution horizontal card approximately3:1 with modest white margins. Exclude surrounding tabs, address, hours, screen/device and logos.
reviewNotes: Original/native/output visibly compared. Neutral heading施設の詳細 and source-faithful Japanese paragraph retain all-ages/picnics/people-watching; native unsupported散歩 wording corrected explicitly. No separate detail link exists in source/mock, so none invented. Regular-weight readable two-line paragraph, balanced spacing and no clipping checked. White rounded card/fine neutral border/restrained shadow; no functional accent. Candidate only, no owner approval/native editability/application behavior.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
